definitions.explanation: A thin line or mark on a surface.
Muscle fibers or tendons in the body.
The main story or sequence of events.
A coherent line of reasoning or proper procedure.

notes:
{筋|すじ} has multiple related meanings centering on the concept of a "line" or "thread."

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {筋|すじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{通|とお}る→通る：01243_tooru⟧ (to make sense, to be logical)
- {筋|すじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{通|とお}す→通す：02300_toosu⟧ (to follow proper procedure)
- ⟦{筋|すじ}{違|ちが}い→筋違い：21040_sujichigai⟧ (irrelevant, off-topic; also: muscle strain)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{血|ち}→血：01659_chi⟧{筋|すじ} (bloodline, lineage)
- ⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧{筋|すじ} (route, path)
- ⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{筋|すじ} (storyline)
- ⟦{筋肉|きんにく}→筋肉：02646_kinniku⟧ (muscle)

SENSE CONNECTIONS:
The meanings are connected through the idea of a continuous line: physical lines → muscle fibers → storyline → logical thread.
